Resolves #20301

The ContextMenuNL leaf-click arm no longer reads a multi-level close from DOM mutation batches, which a loaded runner splits across frames. It sends the `mounted` reads for root, Inspect and Details from the click's own main-thread task, so they reach the App Worker right behind the gesture: the ordering #18884 gave the component tier. The three helpers (`readMountedWithNext`, `mountedWithGesture`, `levelOf`) move to `test/playwright/util/menuLevelReads.mjs`, and both tiers import them. No `src/` change.

Evidence: L2 (local e2e on a private Neural Link bridge with the Brain runtime) → L2 required (AC-1–AC-3); the hosted E2E (Brain-gated tier) run on this PR adds the CI half of AC-3.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one e2e assertion swapped for the component tier's established witness, helpers moved to a shared module, no production code.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `ContextMenuNL.spec.mjs` leaf-click arm: `readMountedWithNext(page, 'click', [root, Inspect, Details])` before the click, then `mountedWithGesture` must equal `[false, false, false]`; `.neo-menu-list` count `0` stays asserted |
| AC-2 | Outside CI, negative control: with `me.getRootMenu().menuFocus = false;` removed from the leaf path in `src/menu/List.mjs`, the arm fails with `[true, true, false]`, because root and Inspect are still mounted in the click's task. Source restored afterwards |
| AC-3 | Outside CI: `--repeat-each=10` → `10 passed (1.7m)`; CI: E2E (Brain-gated tier) on this PR |

## Deltas from ticket
- The ticket's "move to a shared test helper rather than copying" branch was taken: `component/menu/List.spec.mjs` now imports the helpers it used to define.
- `recordLevelCounts` is removed from the e2e spec, because no other arm there used it. The component spec keeps its own copy for single-level steps.

## Test Evidence
- e2e, `NEO_NL_PORT=18093` (a private bridge the fixture spawned and stopped), `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` = `neo-agent-brain` at `a7f9226162`. ContextMenuNL passed 1/1 at `953b318c71`. The 10× repeat ran on the same code before a comment-only edit that the source-archaeology hook required.
- Negative control: see AC-2.
- Component: `test/playwright/component/menu/List.spec.mjs` → `41 passed` with the shared import.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline component + e2e specs ran.
